fix: protection

overlay, with exact hashes and adversarial scanner controls.

feat(protection): deliver fail-closed owner qualification checks

Keep Live qualification closed. The published-trust authority denies destruction without installed custody, and local tests do not make the dependency Available.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
